references.text: False weights are an abomination to the Lord, but full weights are pleasing to him. This verse shares the theme that the Lord detests injustice in trade.
Two kinds of weights and two kinds of measures are both an abomination to the Lord. This verse deals directly with the same theme of unjust weights and measures.
Two kinds of weights are an abomination to the Lord, and a false scale is not good. It repeats the theme that God detests dishonest scales.
You shall do no wrong in judgment, in measure, weight, or volume. You shall have honest weights and honest balances. This is the law that forbids unjust weights.
The prophet Micah condemns false weights and deceit in trade, calling it an abomination to the Lord.
You shall have an honest weight, an honest ephah, and an honest bath. Ezekiel repeats the command for honest weights.
Six things the Lord hates, yes, seven are an abomination to him, including the one who does wrong. The theme that God detests evil and injustice.
